title: Intravesical LGG VS Saline Bladder Wash RCT
official: Intravesical Lactobacillus rhamnosusGG Versus Saline Bladder Wash: A Randomized, Controlled, Comparative Effectiveness Clinical Trial
summary: This is the first ever comparative effectiveness study of an antibiotic-sparing novel self-management intervention to prevent complicated urinary tract infection (UTI).
